title: SecurityScanRequestedEventV1
description: Transactional outbox event emitted when a document is uploaded and requires security scanning (antivirus/malware check) before resume parsing can proceed

event_id.description: Unique UUID for this trigger event

uploaded_by_user_id.description: Registered user who uploaded (null if guest)

guest_upload_session_id.description: Guest session token (null if registered user)

trace_id.description: Distributed tracing UUID (optional, falls back to event_id)

_draft_note: Draft amendment recorded 2026-08-26: document identity only; no storage_url. Dedicated handler remains an implementation gate before producer freeze.
